entries.note: Re-recorded baseline 2026-08-26. 71065 → 81629, inherited drift rather than a change to this package: its own source moved by 4 lines since the previous record (b6432f4), and tsup marks ingest, markdown and types external but NOT @input/pen-core, so this bundle carries a slice of core. Core itself drifted 405550 → 429672 over the same span while staying under its +10% ceiling, which is why the overflow surfaced here first. Byte total reproduced across two clean rebuilds. Pending work on this package's mount lists (UC7) may bring the number down; if it does not, the external list is the thing to revisit, not this budget. _deferred.note: Empty, and discharged rather than abandoned. Three packages (bench, core, dom) were deferred earlier the same day because their sources were being edited while the baseline was taken; each was re-recorded once its work landed and a rebuild produced the same byte count twice. Keep this mechanism: deferring a mid-edit package leaves it failing against the last quiet baseline, which is the honest state, whereas recording a half-finished package silently blesses whatever size it happened to have. Re-record only after a rebuild reproduces the number.
